subsystems.name: Constitutional Kernel
known_limitations: Supreme Constitution v1.0 remains draft until operator explicitly ratifies.
Live AntiGem config.json retains EAGER auto-execution for local tools; consequential/spend/destructive actions are intercepted by PreToolUse hook.

subsystems.name: Intent Compiler
known_limitations: Deterministic structured compiler; natural-language auto-decomposition still relies on host LLM.

subsystems.name: Mission Kernel + Pro2 Problem State
known_limitations: Operator or agent must create a mission via `omega mission new` for cross-session persistence.

subsystems.name: Human Command Interface
known_limitations: CLI interface is live and verified; dedicated AntiGem Mini App GUI dashboard not yet built.

subsystems.name: Cognitive Runtime
known_limitations: Core turn loop is hosted by AntiGem/agy; task-graph auto-scheduler is CLI/workflow driven rather than background daemon.

subsystems.name: Intelligence Fabric (Model Qualification & Routing)
known_limitations: All 4 default catalog models live-qualified on POCO F6 Pro (claude-opus-5-5-medium 8.4s, gemini-4-neon-high 10.9s, gemini-4-hydrogen-low 13.1s, gemini-pro-orchestrator-neon 13.3s); extra agy models remain untested until added to catalog.

subsystems.name: Context Compiler
known_limitations: Uses deterministic character budgeting (5600 char default) rather than model-specific tokenizer counts.

subsystems.name: Knowledge & Evidence Fabric (Scoped-ORC + GrepMem + Evidence Store)
known_limitations: Existing 18 legacy memories default to task_family='global' for backward compatibility; new writes default to scoped.

subsystems.name: Capability Gateway + Weakest-Agent Rings
known_limitations: Subagent ring propagation relies on OMEGA_CALLER_RING env var or explicit delegate_ring() calls until host runtime adds native ring metadata.

subsystems.name: Resource Intelligence
known_limitations: Measures live RAM, disk, DB size, and per-call latency/$0.00 cost; plan-quota percentages come from jarvis_get_usage MCP rather than local DB.

subsystems.name: Assurance & 10-Mission Evaluation Suite
known_limitations: Suite runs deterministically offline in <0.6s using a stub invoker for Mission E; live model probes run separately via `omega models qualify` to preserve 5-hour quota.

subsystems.name: Reliability, Checkpoints & Observability
known_limitations: Mission checkpoints restore SQLite state + verify artifact hashes; arbitrary external network side effects cannot be rolled back automatically.

subsystems.name: Evolution Laboratory (SIM + RRSI + ModularRSI)
known_limitations: Isolated sandbox candidate evaluation, RRSI annealing, SIM logging, and PREPARE_ONLY proposals are verified; autonomous candidate generation loop deferred until live workload traces show specific bottlenecks.
